title: schmidelia thyrsoides

It is a shrub or small tree native to tropical Africa, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Schmidelia thyrsoides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which can help to treat various diseases and conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems.
